subject: EU & APAC data residency - deployment mode follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lukas Jensen <ljensen@nordbank.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-05T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: EU & APAC data residency - deployment mode follow-up

Hi Lukas,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier - really helpful conversation. Quick recap and the next steps so we can align the right deployment option for NordBank.

Recap (from my notes):
- Primary requirement: customer PII and transaction data must remain in the EU for regulated products (GDPR).
- APAC office (SG + Tokyo) runs lower-latency inference for regional fraud detection (hard requirement: <100ms 99th pct).
- Desired: single API surface for your dev teams, but strict controls on where data is processed/stored.
- Compliance asks: SOC 2 Type II evidence, KMS/HSM details, audit logs / retention windows.

Deployment modes we discussed (short):
- Hosted API (Redwood hosted): fast to get started; we can scope EU-only region to keep data in-region for EU workloads.
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pools in customer-specific tenancy (EU region); good for predictable throughput and stronger isolation.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): full customer-managed network and optionally on-prem servers in APAC for local processing.

Outstanding questions for you:
1) For APAC latency requirement, is it acceptable to route only inference traffic to an APAC private deployment (keeping EU storage/retention in EU), or do you need all processing for certain flows to remain in EU?
2) Who should we include from your security/compliance side for the SOC/KMS conversation?

Attachments: I've attached our SOC 2 summary and a deployment options matrix that maps the tradeoffs (Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf, deployment_options_matrix.csv).

Next steps I propose:
- Tech deep-dive with your infra/security and our solutions lead (Aditya) - 30-45 min.
- If the matrix looks good, we'll put together a proposed architecture and an estimated timeline/cost for Dedicated vs Private.

Please let me know availability for a tech call next week (I've copied Aditya to coordinate).

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com

From: Lukas Jensen <ljensen@nordbank.com>

Subject: Re: EU & APAC data residency - deployment mode follow-up

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- EU residency: yes - for any dataset with EU customer PII (including KV caches and any persistent logs), processing and storage must remain within EU borders.
- APAC latency: for the fraud detection product we need sub-100ms 99th pct for inference in SG and JP. Ideally, we prefer local inference in APAC rather than cross-region hops.
- Key management: we prefer customer-managed keys (KMS) and would like to know if Redwood supports HSM-backed keys for Private and Dedicated options.
- Audit/data retention: we will need 12 months of audit logs with export capability to our SIEM.

I'm copying our security lead; they'll take point on the SOC2 and KMS details. They prefer to review your SOC2 report and the proposed architecture before the deep-dive.

Availability for the tech call: Nov 9 or Nov 10 (afternoon CET) should work.

Best,
Lukas
Head of Cloud Architecture | NordBank
ljensen@nordbank.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lukas Jensen <ljensen@nordbank.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, NordBank Security Team <security@nordbank.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: EU & APAC data residency - deployment mode follow-up

Hi Lukas (and security team),

Thanks - this is very helpful. I'll address each of your points and attach concrete options.

Short answers:
- EU residency: Hosted API can be scoped to EU-only (no data leaves EU for the EU workload). For strict regulatory needs we recommend Dedicated (EU-only reserved capacity) or Private VPC (customer-managed) depending on the isolation required.
- APAC latency: To meet <100ms, we recommend a hybrid approach:
  * Control plane and primary storage remain in EU (for PII and audit logs).
  * Deploy Private or Dedicated inference nodes in APAC (SG / Tokyo) for regional low-latency inference.
  * Cross-region routing: requests that must touch EU-only data are proxied; where possible, prefix/KV caching can be used to keep non-PII model context local to APAC.
- KMS/HSM: We support customer-managed KMS for Dedicated and Private. HSM-backed keys are supported via our KMS integrations in Private deployments; for Dedicated we can enable customer KMS with Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK). I've included a short KMS FAQ in the matrix document.
- Audit logs: We provide per-token logs and export hooks; retention windows are configurable and we can provision 12-month retention with an export pipeline to your SIEM (S3/HTTPS push).

I've attached: deployment_options_matrix.csv (maps Hosted / Dedicated / Private), Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf, and a short suggested plan-of-attack (proposed_mop.pptx).

Proposed next steps:
1) Tech deep-dive (30-45 min) - topics: network topology, KMS options, audit/export flows, and APAC deployment timeline.
2) If we align, we'll produce a detailed architecture diagram and cost estimate for Dedicated vs Private.
3) Security review cycle: we'll share SOC2 and technical docs; please send any checklist items from your compliance team and we'll respond within 3 business days.

Suggested times (CET): Nov 9 14:00-14:45, Nov 9 16:00-16:45, Nov 10 15:00-15:45. Aditya (copied) will join on the infra side.

Let us know which slot works and any other folks we should include.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
